items.lede: Playground Games first revealed earlier this year that Forza Horizon 6 would be arriving on PS5 in 2026, but the launch is now being pushed back. I reported last month that there would be a delay to early next year, and Forza Horizon 6 is now officially debuting on January 26th, 2027. The delay means […]
items.title: Forza Horizon 6 is being delayed on PS5 to January 2027

items.lede: The racing game's first expansion will also be available early next year.
